name: eternities-arcadia
intent: Reconcile authorized game direction, runtime systems, player experience, and proof into one bounded playable advance without replacing human judgment or expanding authority.
successCondition: One dominant route produces a verified artifact or change whose player promise, evidence, uncertainty, effects, handoffs, and human-verdict status are explicit.
inputs: authorized game intent repository state and available build evidence
target audience platform session shape multiplayer decision and desired outcome
design runtime accessibility evidence authority and acceptance policies when applicable
outputs: direction runtime experience or proof artifact with verified local changes when authorized
evidence lineage assumptions gaps measurements and human-verdict status
bounded refusal decision request or specialist handoff
operations: preserve player promise and cross-layer contracts
separate deterministic gates measured observations and human judgments
apply local changes within explicit effects and verify representative behavior
produce one bounded artifact and terminate
positiveTriggers: turn a game concept into a testable player promise and production direction
reconcile simulation input persistence networking performance and engine boundaries
improve game feel animation audio effects art coherence and accessibility as one experience
prepare fresh runtime evidence and a human release verdict packet
negativeTriggers: routine isolated code content or asset edit with settled acceptance
generated-content rights ratings or safety decision without current authority
dependency installation signing store upload publication purchase or account mutation
agent self-certification of fun fairness emotional effect or final release readiness
failureModes: the player promise platform networking model or route owner remains unresolved
build evidence is stale unreachable unrepresentative or non-repeatable
rights policy access performance or human play evidence is missing
the requested effect exceeds local read or local write authority
the mission crosses a generated-content shipping administration or external-action boundary
terminationConditions: one dominant route has produced one bounded artifact or verified change
player promise evidence assumptions gaps effects and human-verdict status are visible
unsupported generated external administrative and publication actions are refused or handed off
no recursive background or implied release operation remains
